summary.text: Merv Riepe is a member of the Nebraska Legislature from District 12 who first served in the body from 2015 to 2019, returned in January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former hospital executive and Navy veteran, he serves on the Banking, Commerce and Insurance and Health and Human Services committees.

paragraphs.text: Riepe was born in Griswold, Iowa, graduated from Griswold High School in 1960, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1960 to 1963 as a hospital corpsman.
He earned a B.S. in finance from the University of Nebraska at Omaha in 1968 and an M.A. in health care policy and hospital management from the University of Iowa in 1970.
His career experience includes working as a hospital executive.
According to Ballotpedia, he was a member of the Ralston Board of Education and the Mid-America Council of Scouts board and chaired Outlook Nebraska, Inc.
Riepe represented District 12 in the Nebraska Legislature from 2015 to 2019 and served on the Ralston Public Schools board from 2021 to 2022.
He assumed office again on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Banking, Commerce and Insurance and Health and Human Services.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
